تذاكرت (form VI)
# تَذَاكَرْتُ (taḏākartu) /ta.ðaː.kar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# تَذَاكَرْتَ (taḏākarta) /ta.ðaː.kar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# تَذَاكَرْتِ (taḏākarti) /ta.ðaː.kar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَذَاكَرَ (taḏākara)
# تَذَاكَرَتْ (taḏākarat) /ta.ðaː.ka.rat/: third-person fem
